exec_summary.headline: Agent runtimes are the week’s operating story
exec_summary.body: Across video, live discourse, community threads, open-source work, launches, professional social posts, and research, the practical signal is moving from model novelty to governed agent execution.

exec_summary.headline: Memory and identity need controls
exec_summary.body: Current sources connect persistent context, connector access, and long-running workflows to a requirement for scoped identity, traceability, and rollback.

exec_summary.headline: Enterprise evaluation is becoming lifecycle work
exec_summary.body: Research and product signals favor dated task sets, trajectory review, and a measurable human handoff over one-time benchmark claims.
